title: Getting Started with React Hooks
excerpt: Learn the fundamentals of React Hooks and how to use them effectively in your projects.
author: Omar Faruk
content: React Hooks have revolutionized the way we write React components. They allow you to use state and other React features without writing a class. In this article, we'll explore the most commonly used hooks like useState, useEffect, and useContext.

title: Mastering Tailwind CSS
excerpt: A comprehensive guide to building beautiful UIs with Tailwind CSS utility-first approach.
author: Omar Faruk
content: Tailwind CSS is a utility-first CSS framework that helps you build modern designs without leaving your HTML. Learn how to customize themes, create responsive designs, and optimize your CSS bundle size.

title: Express.js Best Practices
excerpt: Learn professional patterns and practices for building scalable Express.js applications.
author: Omar Faruk
content: Building production-ready Express applications requires following best practices. From middleware configuration to error handling, learn the patterns that professionals use.

title: MongoDB Data Modeling
excerpt: Expert tips on designing efficient and scalable MongoDB schemas for your applications.
author: Omar Faruk
content: MongoDB's flexible schema gives you freedom, but poor design can lead to performance issues. Learn how to model your data effectively for optimal performance.

title: Next.js Full Stack Development
excerpt: Build complete applications with Next.js, from frontend to API routes.
author: Omar Faruk
content: Next.js has become the go-to framework for React applications. Learn how to leverage API routes, SSR, and static generation for full-stack development.

title: Authentication with JWT
excerpt: Implement secure authentication in your applications using JSON Web Tokens.
author: Omar Faruk
content: JWT (JSON Web Tokens) provide a stateless way to handle authentication. Learn how to implement JWT properly in your Node.js applications with best security practices.
